age.evidence: Male and female Sprague Dawley rats (~8 weeks old) ... Animals underwent fiber photometry/behavioral recordings at ~12 weeks of age.

sex.evidence: Male and female Sprague Dawley rats (200-400g, ~8-weeks old at arrival)

dosing.evidence: psilocin (Cayman Chemical) was dissolved in 2% glacial acetic acid and brought up to a 1 mg/ml dilution in 0.9% saline. Animals then received subcutaneous (s.c.) injections of either vehicle (2% glacial acetic acid in 0.9% saline) or psilocin

group_housing.evidence: Following intracranial surgery at ~8 weeks of age, animals were single-housed in flat-lid cages with waterspout access, and food bowls to avoid damage to implants.

judge_notes: Merged candidates' separate 'Open Field habituation' and 'Air-puff' assays into a single assay because they occur in the same apparatus, same recording session (10-min habituation immediately followed by air-puff trials), and measure overlapping locomotor/threat-response variables. Per rubric, dose/timepoint/active-vs-passive subgroup splits do not create separate assays.
Excluded c-Fos histology (non-behavioural), fiber photometry signal analysis (neural recording), and CORT ELISA (physiological) from assay list per rubric.
Excluded restraint stress as separate assay - it is a stressor manipulation prior to the air-puff recording, not an independent behavioural test.
Group housing scored 'no' because methods explicitly state animals were single-housed after surgery (during the experimental period).
D2 scored 1 (15-60 min): habituation (10 min) + post-puff/ISI period (5 min minimum) likely exceeds 15 min total recording per session, though exact total session length not explicitly stated.
